summary: Allbirds, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to register the sale of up to $50 million of its Class A common stock through an at-the-market (ATM) offering with Chardan Capital Markets as sales agent. The offering is conducted under an existing S-3 shelf registration. Shares will be sold at market prices, with Chardan receiving up to 3% commission. No fixed price, premium, or special-situation trigger is present; this is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown. The filing involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or structural event. Caution: nothing to watch or risk-arb angle as it is an ordinary equity distribution.
